rowgen.name: SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.detector
rowgen.check: SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.detector : ∀ (C : SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.WeilConfig), ∀ ρ₀ ∈ C.carrier, ρ₀.re ≠ 1 / 2 → ∃ a j, SIDEExplicitFormula.B321.classK (SIDEExplicitFormula.B321.kWindow a (SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.detectorBase ρ₀) j) ∧ Function.support (SIDEExplicitFormula.B321.pwWindow a (SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.detectorBase ρ₀) j) ⊆ Set.Icc (-(2 ^ j * SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.baseWidth ρ₀)) (2 ^ j * SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.baseWidth ρ₀) ∧ (SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.zeroSide_cfg C (SIDEExplicitFormula.B321.kWindow a (SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.detectorBase ρ₀) j)).re < 0
rowgen.doc: **THE DETECTOR THEOREM**: for a configuration of the schema with a point `ρ₀` off the line, there are a coefficient list `a` and a power `j` such that the window `kWindow a (detectorBase ρ₀) j` is in classK, its pre-pairing factor is supported in `[-(2^j w), 2^j w]` with `w = baseWidth ρ₀`, and its zero side has negative real part.

rowgen.name: SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.not_h2_sign_cfg_of_offline
rowgen.doc: **The detector's consequence**: a configuration of the schema with a point off the line is not Weil-positive on classK
